thesis: CERT just ran to a 52-week high on an earnings gap and has already printed a bearish reversal (open 12.25, close 11.73) with pre-market weaker at about 11.57, so the catalyst is priced in and momentum is rolling over. Fundamentals are mixed: services is soft and full-year growth guidance was narrowed to 2%-3%. Short interest near 26% of float means reversals are violent in both directions. The regime is neutral with tech and growth under pressure from a 10-year yield at 5.048 (percentile 0.894), and the card's own reward/risk of 1.74 is thin, with only about 0.9 to the first resistance at 12.61. Waiting for a confirmed hold of the 10.86 SMA20 or the gap base is better than buying a fading post-earnings spike.
